yacl3.config.minecraft:stackedoverlaymes: Master toggle for stacked overlay messages.
How many overlay messages can be shown at once, including the newest one.
How similar the unformatted text of two messages must be for the older one to be discarded instead of stacked. 100% requires an exact match. 0% treats every message as similar.
Restrict stacking to a whitelist or blacklist of servers. Use singleplayer for local worlds.
Server addresses (host or host:port) used by the whitelist or blacklist.
